Name: Wizard without Gold for SVE - Sprite and Portrait
Author: CeNedra133742
Description:
The very important history of this mod:

This is not actually a real mod, but I opened paint.net and recolored some pixels. As someone on Reddit asked me to upload it: here
you are. :)

I just wanted to marry Magnus and was superficial enough that I wanted him to look more like a serious wizard and I really did not like his
golden earrings. Since I was already on it, I removed all the gold and then proceeded to remove those spikes on his hat and now I really like the way he changed. Then I saw his sprite in a white nightgown and that had to go as well...

__________________________

2.0 Update
----------------------
I finally dared to tackle the Portrait, too. Removed the "cowboy-horns" on his hat and the gold on his hat and collar. I am actually quite happy with the result.

Both portrait and sprite are independent of each other, so you can use both or only one of them.

__________________________

1.0 Version
----------------------

This "mod" removes the Wizards' sprites' golden earrings, as well as his golden belt and necklace. The robe will just be black, the earrings just disappear.

His night robe is now grey (because I think he looks much more respectable in a non-white nightgown. ;) )

Nothing else will change, not his Portrait, not his behavior, nothing.

This mod will (afaik) only work for Stardew Valley Expanded, as it contains just a .PNG-file that you have to replace the original file with. I do not know how to replace the file in vanilla SDV.

__________________________

Installation Guide
----------------------

This mod just contains two  .png-files that can be downloaded separately.[b]

Sprite:

This .png-file goes here:[/b]
[u]
[/u][u]Mods > Stardew Valley Expanded > [CP] Stardew Valley Expanded > assets > CharacterFiles > Overworld Sprites > Magnus

[u]Make a copy of the original file somewhere safe, replace it with the downloaded file and rename the downloaded file "Magnus.png".[/u]

[/u]You will have to replace this file again, every time you update the Stardew Valley Expanded-Mod.

[b]Portrait:

This .png-file goes here:[/b]
[u]
[/u][u]Mods > Stardew Valley Expanded > [CP] Stardew Valley Expanded > assets > CharacterFiles > Portraits > Magnus
[u]
[u]Make a copy of the original file somewhere safe, replace it with the downloaded file and rename the downloaded file "Magnus.png".[/u][/u]

[/u]You will have to replace this file again, every time you update the Stardew Valley Expanded-Mod.
